title: Kosher Earthy Feta Braise
description: This meal-prep Ethiopian dish features earthy and chewy feta cheese braised with aromatic spices to create a flavorful side or main course.
instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, combine feta cheese with tomato sauce and cover. Simmer gently for about 10 minutes until heated through.
Add chopped onions, minced garlic, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, turmeric powder, salt, and paprika to the pot. Stir well to mix evenly.
Pour in water and bring the mixture to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover with a lid, and let it simmer for about 20-30 minutes until all liquid is absorbed and cheese is fully heated.
Garnish with fresh cilantro if desired before serving.
Serve hot as a side dish or over cooked grains like rice or injera.
